fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: NASA API key (optional)
fields.hint: Only used when science.nasa.gov cannot be reached: the scene then asks api.nasa.gov, whose shared DEMO_KEY allows only a few requests an hour for everyone on your network. A free key from api.nasa.gov allows 1,000 an hour.

nasaApod.name: NASA picture of the day
nasaApod.description: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day with its title, date, credit and explanation, fetched from science.nasa.gov (api.nasa.gov as the fallback) once a day.
